label: scam
title: Lottery -- pay fees to claim prize

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Congratulations! You've won $50,000 in the state sweepstakes!

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: To release the funds we just need a $600 processing fee in gift cards today.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This offer expires at midnight, so act now and keep it confidential until you're paid.
